name: raisedadead-plugins
description: Two Claude Code plugins that make "done" a checkable fact: dossier drives a wave of work from one resumable ledger, whetstone applies the craft at each gate.

plugins.name: dossier
plugins.description: Phase-scoped engineering workflow: single-file DOSSIER.md, cross-repo state, drift detection, resumable builds, evidence log. Composes the whetstone plugin at phase gates when installed (doubt, TDD proof, merge check, skill lint) — fully functional without it.

plugins.name: whetstone
plugins.description: Engineering-craft skills: red-green TDD, a flaky-test rate, diagnosis, doubt review, grilling, a merge check, grounded research reports, HTML reports, skill linting and a staged-diff column budget. TDD, the flaky-test rate, the merge check, skill lint, column budget and HTML report end in a script's exit code; doubt review, grilling, diagnosis and the research verdicts are model-judgment. Auto-composed by the dossier plugin at its phase gates when both are installed — fully functional standalone.
